The four sections, from the catalogue to each page

Your round-6 rulings (R1 to R5, all A) are applied. Every frame is a screenshot of the app running a local prototype in its own styles, on the golden chart at age 31. The app code is restored and nothing was pushed. Each section below shows the tap that leads to it, then the page. Where the free view differs from the paid one, both are shown.

1 · The catalogue, with the round-6 rulings

Your Reading→below YOUR ENERGY MAP

The four new beats and the words note, which now teaches Seat, Gate, Decade and Star (R3)

The top of the page (the hero, YOUR ENERGY MANUAL and the dominance wheel) is unchanged, exactly as in round 6. Tapping a tile opens its page (R2). Tapping a domain icon or a star chip opens that reading directly.

2 · Domains

Your Reading→the YOUR DOMAINS tile

Domains page · free

Free in full: every headline, plus "How you are" on each domain. A card opens that domain’s reading. A domain icon on an energy page or a door in THE EDGE opens the same reading.

3 · A domain reading: Wealth

the Wealth card, an energy page icon or an EDGE door→Wealth

Seeker view

Free view

The life line lights only the seats that rule Wealth. Under "By position" sits "How you are" (free), then one block per seat in gate order, with the gap row at the Month Gate. By decade and By year are the Advisor tabs. At the foot, a link opens your Wealth across your Life Chapters.

4 · Life Chapters (the pillars, with 大运)

Your Reading→the YOUR LIFE CHAPTERS tile, or the Today tab’s "This Decade"

Seeker view

Free: the life line, the decade strip, each chapter’s name and status, its seats and its domains. Seeker: the chapter and decade readings. Advisor: each year of the current decade (the lock card under the years).

5 · Stars (神煞)

Your Reading→the YOUR STARS tile or a star chip

Seeker view

Free view

Each card shows the star’s name in its catalogue chip style, the 汉字, its gate, a one-line claim, then the reading. The two hardest stars share one collapsed row. The stars your decades bring appear at Seeker; those your years bring, at Advisor.

6 · Energy Blueprint (Advisor)

Your Reading→Going deeper→the YOUR ENERGY BLUEPRINT tile, or the Day Master page door

Free and Seeker view

Advisor view

Part 2 reuses the Seek and Ease pills and the wheel’s watercolour plates, so the Blueprint reads as the "why" behind YOUR ENERGY MANUAL. The classical names keep their 汉字 as texture (E9).
